points: The first thing the children of Dan did in the land the Most High allowed them to take was set up the graven image, a god made by the hands of a man they had just robbed. Jonathan the son of Gershom, the son of Manasseh, he and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan until the day of the captivity of the land, and they kept Micah's graven image all the time the house of God was in Shiloh.

note.label: Judges 18: Dan Steals Micah's Gods and Takes Laish
